SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그 사람 병원 어디에서 본지 기억해요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Do you remember which hospital we saw her at?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你还记得是在医院哪里见过那位小姐的吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你還記得在醫院哪裡看到那個人嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: この人 どこの病院で見たか 覚えてますか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Apakah kamu ingat di rumah sakit mana kita menemuinya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você se lembra em que parte do hospital viu essa pessoa?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Recuerdas en qué parte del hospital viste a esa persona?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یادت هست در کدام بیمارستان اونو دیدیم؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I do remember, but...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 记得是记得...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 記得是記得…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: うん 覚えてはいるけど…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku ingat, tapi...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim, mas… hã… já que estamos aqui
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Sí, pero… mmm… ya que estamos aquí
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یادم هست اما...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 음… 온 김에 규리 쌤한테 여쭤 볼까?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hmm... since we’re here, maybe we can ask Ms. Gyu-ri?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 嗯...来都来了，要不顺便问问方护士？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 嗯…既然來了，要不問問久梨護理師吧？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: うーん… 来たついでに ギュリ先生に聞いてみようか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hmm... karena kita sudah di sini, mungkin kita bisa bertanya pada Nona Gyu-ri?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: por que não perguntamos pra enfermeira Gyuri?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿por qué no le preguntamos a la enferma Gyuri?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هوم... چون اینجا هستیم، شاید بتوانیم از خانم گیو ری بپرسیم؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: One sec—where is she...?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 稍等一下？方护士在哪呢...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 等一下？久梨護士在哪裡呢…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ちょっと待ってください ギュリ先生どこだろ…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tunggu sebentar—di mana dia...?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Um momento, onde ela está…?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Un momento, ¿dónde está…?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یک ثانیه - او کجاست...؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Were you looking for me?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 请问，是在找我吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你找我嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: もしかして 私を探してました？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Apakah kamu mencari aku?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tavam me procurando?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Me estaban buscando?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: دنبال من بودی؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh! Nurse Gyu-ri! Are you working today?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哦老师！今天是您值班吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你好，久梨護理師！今天你值班嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: おっ 先生！ 今日は勤務日なんですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Oh! Perawat Gyu-ri! Apakah kamu bekerja hari ini?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, enfermeira! Hoje é dia de trabalho?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Oh, enfermera! ¿Hoy le toca trabajar?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه! پرستار گیو ری! امروز کار میکنی؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yep! Just about to wrap up, though.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 嗯！虽然快下班了...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 是啊！不過快下班了…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい もうすぐ終わるところなんですけど…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yep! Sebentar lagi selesai.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim, mas já tô quase terminando!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Sí, ¡aunque ya casi termino!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بله! با این حال، فقط در شرف اتمام است.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 어, 근데 오늘 유만 씨 진료 없는 걸로 아는데
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wait, isn’t today one of your off days, Yuman?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 呃，今天宥万先生应该没有诊疗安排才对
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊，今天宥萬先生應該沒有要回診啊
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あれ？ 今日はユマンさん 診察ないはずですよね？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tunggu, bukankah hari ini salah satu hari liburmu, Yuman?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Hã, mas pelo que lembro, o senhor não tinha consulta hoje, senhor Yumán.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Eh, pero según recuerdo, hoy no tenía cita médica, señor Yumán.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صبر کن، امروز یکی از روزهای تعطیل تو نیست، یومان؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Are you feeling okay?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 是哪里不舒服吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 有哪裡不舒服嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: どこか痛いんですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Apakah kamu baik-baik saja?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tá se sentindo mal?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Se siente mal?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شما احساس خوبی دارید؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh no, it’s not that—
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊不是，不是那样的
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊，不，不是那樣的…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ いえ そういうことじゃなくて
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Oh tidak, bukan itu—
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, não, não é isso.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah, no, no es eso.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه نه، این نیست -

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: There’s someone who works here, cleaning staff.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 请问医院保洁人员里
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 請問醫院清潔人員中
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: この病院で清掃してる人で
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ada seseorang yang bekerja di sini, staf kebersihan.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: É que entre o pessoal da limpeza do hospital
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Solo que entre el personal de limpieza del hospital
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یک نفر اینجا کار می کند، کارکنان نظافت.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Her name’s Yu-jeong Yang.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 有没有一个叫梁有情的
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 有沒有一位叫做梁有情的人
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ヤン・ユジョンって人
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Namanya Yu-jeong Yang.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: tem uma mulher chamada Yujeong Yang,
SCRIPT.SPANISH: hay una mujer llamada Yujeong Yang,
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نام او یو جونگ یانگ است.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: She’s got bangs that kind of hang heavy over her forehead,
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 刘海像这样蓬松垂下来的
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 瀏海亂糟糟垂下來
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 前髪がこう ふわっと下がってて
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dia punya poni yang agak menggantung berat di dahinya,
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: com a franja bem comprida e bagunçada,
SCRIPT.SPANISH: con el flequillo así, bien largo y desordenado,
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چتری هایی دارد که به شدت روی پیشانی اش آویزان شده است،

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 얼굴은 좀 동글동글한데, 귀엽게 생긴 여자 못 봤어요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: round face, really cute—have you seen anyone like that?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 脸有点圆圆的，长相可爱的女生？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 臉圓圓，長得很可愛的女生？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 顔はちょっと丸くて かわいい感じの人なんですけど
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: wajah bulat, imut banget—pernahkah kamu melihat orang seperti itu?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: o rostinho redondo, mas muito bonito. Você não viu ela?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: la cara redondita, pero muy linda. ¿No la ha visto?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صورت گرد، واقعاً بامزه - کسی را چنین دیده اید؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hmm... there are a lot of cleaning staff, so I’m not sure...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 这个嘛...保洁人员实在太多了...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 嗯…清潔人員實在太多了…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: うーん… 清掃の方は結構たくさんいるからなぁ…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hmm... banyak petugas kebersihannya, jadi aku tidak yakin...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Hã… tem muita gente na limpeza…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Mmm… hay muchas personas en limpieza…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هوم... تعداد زیادی پرسنل نظافتچی هستند، بنابراین مطمئن نیستم...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: But wow, sounds like you were paying reaaally close attention?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不过您观察得可真仔~细啊？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不過，你好像看得很仔細啊？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でも ずいぶん詳しく覚えてるんですね？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi wow, kedengarannya kamu benar-benar memperhatikan dengan saksama?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: mas parece que você reparou bem nos detalhes, hein?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: pero parece que la miraste con mucho detalle, ¿eh?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اما وای، به نظر می رسد که شما واقعاً به دقت توجه کرده اید؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah—that’s, uh... it just kinda happened that way...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊，那个，就是碰巧看到...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊，那個啊，碰巧就看到了…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ それは まぁ たまたま その…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah—itu, uh... itu terjadi begitu saja...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, bom, foi sem querer, é que…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah, bueno, fue sin querer, es que…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه-همین، اوه... اینطوری اتفاق افتاد...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oppa! Did you find her?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哥哥！找到了吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 哥哥！找到了嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お兄さん！ 見つけました？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Oppa! Apa kau menemukannya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Oppa! Achou ela?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Oppa! ¿La encontraste?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یومان! اونو پیدا کردی؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wait—who’s this?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不过这位是...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不過這位是…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: えっ でも その人は 誰…？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tunggu—siapa ini?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: E quem é ela…?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Y quién es ella…?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: صبر کن - این کیه؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh~ so you’re here with someone again today, huh?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊~今天又是和谁“一起”来的啊
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊～今天又是和誰「一起」…來的吧
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ〜 今日も誰かと“一緒に”来てるんですね
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Oh~ jadi kamu di sini dengan seseorang lagi hari ini, ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah~ então veio acompanhado de novo...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah~ así que otra vez vino acompañado...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه~ پس امروز دوباره با کسی اینجایی، نه؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아 여기는 그 민정 씨... 헙!!!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, this is... Min-jung... *Gasp*
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊，这位是那位敏静小姐... 天啊！！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊，這位是敏靜小姐…哈！！！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ こちらは その ミンジョンさん… えっ！？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ah, ini... Min-jung... *Terkesiap*
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, essa é a senhorita Minjung… ops!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ah, ella es la señorita Minjung… ¡ups!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، این است... مین‌جونگ... *نفس*

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Min-jung? No way—don’t tell me...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 朴敏静？不会吧
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 樸敏靜？不會吧…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ミンジョン？ まさか…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Min-jung? Nggak mungkin—jangan bilang...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Minjung? Não pode ser…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Minjung? No puede ser…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: مین‌جونگ؟ به هیچ وجه - به من نگو ​​...
